environment.description: Container deployed on ECS Fargate with task definition specifying readonlyRootFilesystem: true. No volume mounts, no EFS attachments, no bind mounts configured in the task definition. The container's ephemeral storage layer (20GB default) is present but the rootfs overlay upper directory is mounted read-only per the OCI runtime spec enforcement. Task networking uses awsvpc mode with security group sg-0a4f2c8e allowing only inbound 443 from ALB. Note: Fargate platform version 1.4.0 enforces the readonlyRootFilesystem constraint at the containerd/runc level via the OCI bundle config.json 'readonly' rootfs option, which makes all filesystem paths including /tmp read-only unless explicitly overridden with a volume mount.

config.note: ephemeralStorage is allocated but not mounted as a writable volume to the container path
